description:
Implements ADR-005 decision 8 (compliance portion). Anthropic is a SUB-PROCESSOR (user data is sent to its API for synthesis): sign the DPA, disclose it in the privacy policy, record lawful basis + Records of Processing. Move the Fly app + /data volume to an EU region (or document data location) and enable encryption at rest on the volume. Privacy Policy + Terms of Service + breach-notification process — generate a baseline (Iubenda/Termly) then a lawyer pass; do not hand-roll GDPR text. Storing users' cognitive fingerprints makes this load-bearing, not optional.

Registration / representation obligations (often missed — confirm with the lawyer review):
- EU representative (GDPR Art. 27): as a non-EU controller serving EU data subjects, we likely must appoint an EU-based representative. Cheap to satisfy via a service (~€100–300/yr) but must be in place before taking EU customers.
- UK ICO registration + annual data-protection fee if we serve UK users; check equivalent supervisory-authority registration for other jurisdictions.
- Confirm whether incidental special-category data (Art. 9 — users may log health/political/religious content in sessions) triggers a higher bar (explicit consent, possible DPIA).

Engagement model: DIY the drafting, then ONE fixed-fee privacy-specialist review of the ToS + Privacy Policy before charging the first EU customer (one-time cost, not ongoing counsel). The lawyer's job is the three items above plus lawful-basis/DSR adequacy — things generated docs can't decide. Add an explicit ToS line telling users not to paste secrets/special-category data they don't want retained.
title: GDPR compliance pack: sub-processor DPA, EU residency, encryption at rest, Privacy Policy + ToS
